description: This file defines the CheckOutHelper class which acts as a facade over the ShoppingCart to facilitate the complex process of creating and managing orders, including setting addresses, payment options, calculating taxes, creating orders, and processing payments within an OFBiz-based e-commerce system.

classes.name: CheckOutHelper
classes.description: A facade over the ShoppingCart to simplify order creation, address setting, payment processing, tax calculation, and order finalization within the OFBiz e-commerce framework.

methods.name: setCheckOutShippingAddress
methods.description: Sets the shipping address for the checkout process based on the provided contact mech ID.

methods.name: setCheckOutShippingAddressInternal
methods.description: Internal method to update checkout cart with the shipping contact mechanism, returning error messages if any.

methods.name: setCheckOutShippingOptions
methods.description: Sets shipping options including method, instructions, gift options, date constraints, and additional emails.

methods.name: setCheckOutShippingOptionsInternal
methods.description: Internal method to update the cart with shipping options and validate input.

methods.name: setCheckOutPayment
methods.description: Sets payment methods and accounts for checkout, including validation and handling billing accounts.

methods.name: setCheckOutPaymentInternal
methods.description: Internal method to process and validate selected payment methods, billing accounts, and amounts.

methods.name: setCheckOutDates
methods.description: Sets shipping before and after dates in the cart.

methods.name: setCheckOutOptions
methods.description: Comprehensive method to set shipping, address, payment, and recalculate taxes and shipping costs.

methods.name: checkGiftCard
methods.description: Handles gift card validation, creation, and assigned payment method for the checkout process.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates an order from the current cart for the specified user login.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Overloaded; creates an order with additional tracking info and options.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes payment for the current order, with overloads for face-to-face and manual hold options.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Static method to process and authorize payments, handle external payment methods, and manage order statuses.

methods.name: adjustFaceToFacePayment
methods.description: Adjusts face-to-face payment preferences to match the order total, creating cash payment preferences as needed.

methods.name: checkOrderDenyList
methods.description: Checks whether the order shipping address or credit card is on a deny list, returning success or failure accordingly.

methods.name: checkOrderDenylist
methods.description: Deprecated method that calls checkOrderDenyList.

methods.name: failedDenylistCheck
methods.description: Handles denial of order due to deny list, disables user login, rejects order, and clears the cart.

methods.name: checkExternalPayment
methods.description: Verifies if the order uses an external payment gateway and returns the type of external payment if applicable.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryShip
methods.description: Sets shipping contact, supplier, and agreement IDs for a specific order entry (ship group).

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryOptions
methods.description: Sets shipping, instructions, gift options, internal code, and shipping dates for a ship group.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryOptions (overload with more params)
methods.description: Sets shipping options, gift message, internal notes, and estimates for a ship group.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryOptions (full detailed)
methods.description: Sets shipping method, instructions, gift message, internal code, dates, notes, and estimates, with validation.

methods.name: finalizeOrderEntryPayment
methods.description: Sets the payment ID, amount, and options during checkout.

methods.name: availableAccountBalance
methods.description: Calculates the available balance of a billing account via dispatcher, with an overload that uses class's dispatcher.

methods.name: makeBillingAccountMap
methods.description: Creates a map of billing accounts to their maximum amounts from payment preferences.

methods.name: validatePaymentMethods
methods.description: Validates that the selected payment methods and amounts cover the order total and checks gift card balances.

methods.name: validateGiftCardAmounts
methods.description: Checks gift card balances via external services and updates the cart's gift card payment amounts accordingly.
